title: Sequential sampling with replacement and bonus draws
text: There are 6 coupon types. Each purchase yields one coupon uniformly at random. Whenever you obtain a new type for the first time, you immediately receive 5 bonus coupons (each uniformly random and independent). You stop when you have collected at least 2 distinct types. Compute the expected number of purchases.
